notes.title: Sigils of Nightfall joins the No Time to Loot Festival 2025
notes.content:
Sigils of Nightfall is part of the No Time to Loot Festival, from September 22nd to 29th, 2025. And we have excellent news!

The long wait is finally over. The moment you’ve been waiting for has arrived.

Sigils of Nightfall is opening its gates for you to join the Playtest. Step into the darkness, test your will, and help shape the game with your feedback at our Discord server.

Playtest is out now!

notes.title: New Card Designs Unveiled
notes.content:
Our team has been working hard on a significant update in Sigils of Nightfall: the introduction of new card types and disturbing visuals that deepen and enrich the gameplay experience. We reimagined each card, creating a darker, more immersive aesthetic that embodies the game’s themes.

New Card Types
Prepare to discover new card types that unlock unique strategies, add fresh layers to deckbuilding, and create deeper interactions within battles. From devastating offensive abilities to relentless curses that bring ruin over time, every card holds the power to seal your fate.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/45820c3faee155214764417bced8e1be88e9e55b.png
Art & Visuals
Each card has been given a stunning visual overhaul, with distinctive artwork that reflects the sinister beauty of Sigils of Nightfall’s universe. Our goal was to make each card a work of art, embodying the dark apocalyptic atmosphere and occult mystique that define the game.

Card Anatomy
The card interface has also been refined to deliver a smoother, more intuitive experience. Each card type now has unique style cues, and the layout is clearer, making it easier to navigate your deck and execute strategic decisions in the heat of battle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45077500/61a403e3c2d1101b48a44147a659039c62936845.png
Unleash these new powers. The darkness awaits!
